media.title: Ernst Marischka — portrait in Moderne Welt (1925)
media.description: Portrait crop from a page about the new operetta Der Orlow. The printed caption identifies the upper portrait as librettist Ernst Marischka and the adjacent portrait as composer Bruno Granichstädten.
media.altText: Black-and-white 1925 portrait of librettist Ernst Marischka in a dark suit and tie.
